name: Kirkland Signature Chilled Cooked Tail-On Shrimp Cocktail Platter
whyItWorks: Peeled, deveined, perfectly steamed tail-on shrimp ready to eat from the deli case. Shrimp is virtually fat-free, completely fiber-free, and delivers clean bioavailable marine protein that places zero strain on inflamed bowel segments.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the chilled shrimp plain or with a light pinch of salt. Avoid dipping into the included horseradish cocktail sauce during active symptoms.
